column7: 3.x main is a breaking major: download and tokenization become protocols you must implement yourself
iOS jetsam gives no signal: no throw, no memory-warning callback, no deinit — the app just closes on the user
A missing or mismatched chat template yields fluent but degraded output blamed on the model — nothing checks it
Resolver patches are mostly inert: only reasoningConfig is consumed; extraEOSTokens and toolCallFormat change nothing
mlx-swift-lm main is a breaking 3.x major — code written against 2.x loading APIs no longer applies
The 3.x upgrade-notes URL 404s (issue #217) — read Documentation.docc/upgrade.md in the repo instead
MLXCXGrammar and MLXHuggingFaceMacros are targets, not products — briefs listing them as importable are wrong
The upgrade document's own migration table contains stale module names
skipSpecialTokens defaults to false — decoded text keeps special tokens unless you opt out
Split tokenizer repos get a no-op progress handler: the bar hits 100% while a second unreported download runs
Macro expansion references six modules at your call site — missing imports error inside code you never wrote
Linking only MLXLMCommon empties the registry; the free loader shows the VLM error, hiding the real LLM failure
Bare HubClient caches weights in Library/Caches — iOS purges it under storage pressure and multi-GB models vanish
generation_config.json eos_token_id replaces rather than unions — earlier stop tokens silently discarded
The bundled skill's loading code is stale against the 3.x API in the same repo
SerialAccessContainer and SendableBox are package-scoped — reimplement the pattern or use ModelContainer
SendableBox.consume() fatalErrors on a second call — a one-shot type that crashes instead of erroring
Backgrounding with GPU work in flight aborts the process via an uncatchable Metal handler — cancel and await on scenePhase
Streams always end with a .info event carrying stopReason and timings — rely on it, but don't copy llm-tool's fatalError
The GPU cache API was renamed and both spellings circulate — verify which your version exports
Memory.cacheLimit is one process-wide value and libraries set it behind your back — your setting can be silently stomped
Memory.snapshot() reports MLX's allocator only, not process footprint — it cannot warn you about jetsam
Two ticket(...) spellings for wired memory exist in the repo and one is stale
Jetsam arrives with no throw, no reliable memory warning, no deinit — 'Terminated due to memory issue' is all you get
ChatSession's default processing resizes every image to 512×512 — detail silently lost unless you override
A VLM factory processor-selection gotcha produces wrong output rather than an error
Dropped EXIF orientation feeds the model a rotated photo — wrong answers, no error; Apple fixed it in their own sample
Evidence on the EXIF fix conflicts between research passes — reported as conflicting, not smoothed over
PhotosPicker's receivedFile.file lives in a temp dir deleted after the closure — copy it out or the URL dies
An empty assistant placeholder passed to UserInput(chat:) closes the turn — garbage or empty output blamed on the model
Fused SDPA is head-dim-gated; unsupported dims silently materialise an L² score tensor — inexplicable prefill memory
NSCache eviction isn't coordinated with MLX, and Apple's snippet re-stomps the process-wide cacheLimit on every load
@available alone is not enough — without the trait/linker gate the app fails at runtime on OSes that compiled fine
27-beta SDK churn: an interface/dylib mismatch escalates from silent drift to a SIGSEGV process abort
Parallel xctest workers race on the shared HuggingFace cache — intermittent corruption that looks like a checkpoint bug
Template resolution has a silent failure mode: a wrong template degrades output with no error (§6)
Scope note: trust no signature below without the stated verification caveats
Four items were not read this session and are deliberately not asserted
Marker definition: SILENT FAILURE means it does not throw — this guide catalogues nine
The MLXLLM and MLXVLM README links are genuinely dead — not a transcription error
#hubDownloader macros expand to symbols at your call site — missing imports produce baffling errors in generated code
Images are resized to 512×512 by the default processing unless you say otherwise
ChatSession is not thread-safe — the source says one task at a time; concurrent use corrupts state unguarded
MLXArray is not Sendable — perform callers must eval() before returning values out or they race the stream
Tool-only responses emit zero .chunk events (.toolCall then .info) — a spinner keyed to first text hangs forever
numDraftTokens defaults to 5 via SpeculativeDecodingConfig but 2 via free generate(draftModel:) — economics shift
MTP drafters need manual registration; without it decoding silently falls back to single-token — no speedup, no error
Swift temperature defaults to 0.6, not 0 — ports assuming Python's greedy default sample stochastically
seed is inert at temperature 0 — greedy decoding never consults the RNG
maxTokens nil means unlimited — deliberate in llm-tool, a runaway generation in an app
At temperature 0 every sampler knob is ignored; topP 1.0 and topK 0 are also no-ops — decorative config fields
Prefill runs inside the cache initializer — constructing it is the expensive step, not a cheap allocation
The third initializer explicitly disables cache quantization — choose it and kvBits quietly stops applying
Dropping LMOutput.State between turns drifts M-RoPE positions on VLMs — degraded multi-turn output, no error
prompt.didSet doesn't fire in init — mutating images after chat-based construction desyncs media from messages
A trailing empty assistant message closes the turn — fresh user turn or instant EOS on the raw UserInput path
The VLM factory runs first and intermediate errors are swallowed — the message you see may be the wrong factory's
Stop-token step 2 replaces rather than unions (matching Python) — earlier EOS ids silently discarded
stopStrings nil falls back to extraEOSTokens — nil and empty array behave differently
A bare-id load bypasses the registry — no extraEOSTokens or curated defaults; same model, different behavior
The chat template is the contract and nothing checks it — mismatches produce fluent, degraded output
A tool Output that fails to encode becomes '{}' silently — the model reasons over an empty result, no error
gemma's exact-equality rule misses family variants — they fall through to the .json default
Unknown models default to .json tool format — a non-JSON model's tool calls stream into visible text, never firing
toolCallFormat matches 'gemma' by exact equality while every other family uses hasPrefix
Mixing ToolCallProcessor's two APIs on one instance corrupts its streaming state machine — the source forbids it
Returning a string for an unknown tool (not throwing) is the right default — the model can read the failure and retry
A protocol-extension-only ropeOffset would be statically shadowed — subclass overrides silently ignored via existentials
trimPromptCache returns 0 instead of throwing on untrimmable caches — the trim quietly does nothing
newCache derives cache count from kvHeads.count — an unassigned empty array builds zero caches and crashes
keep:4 attention sinks make rotating caches unquantizable/unmergeable in Python; the Swift guard is unverified
kvScheme overrides kvBits and typo'd scheme strings are silently ignored — no quantization, no message
RotatingKVCache.toQuantized() is never called — rotating layers silently stay fp16 whatever kvBits says
gpt-oss attention sinks are incompatible with quantized SDPA — a family-specific hard stop
Restore plus instructions doubles the system prompt — fluent nonsense; saveCache also drops M-RoPE state (#443)
Calling cache.update(...) yourself before attentionWithCacheUpdate double-applies it and corrupts the cache
quantizedKVStart 0 quantizes from token zero — Python measured a quality cost that a later start avoids
Detection-script print: caches without rollback or prefix reuse make speculative decoding unsafe
Detection-script print: rotating layers make trimmability temporary — it lapses once the window wraps (#424)
Detection-script print: surfaces the kvBits and quantizedKVStart combination so the trade-off is visible

Inputs beyond maxPositionEmbeddings are truncated with only a console warning — never an error
Hybrid and linear-attention models have no prefix caching — every RAG query re-prefills; 0.2 s vs 20 s to first token
@available alone won't save you — the adapter's own header demands a runtime gate as well
A missing import at the macro call site errors inside the expansion — the message never names the import fix
noModelFactoryAvailable surfaces mid-download when MLXLLM isn't imported — the error site hides the linking cause
swift test does not work on this package — use xcodebuild with -skipPackagePluginValidation (and -skipMacroValidation)
Session 339's one-argument MLXLanguageModel init does not exist — code written from the session will not compile
progressHandler is ignored for local-directory loads — no progress events ever arrive on that path
The SDK never gates image input on .vision — without the adapter's check, images go to text-only models silently
.available does not mean the weights are complete — a partial download still reports available
A prewarm witness that doesn't match exactly never binds — prewarm silently no-ops, first-token latency stays high
Scope note on the logger: some drops surface only at debug level — logging bounds what it can save you from
TranscriptConverter drops entries with only debug-level logs — transcript content quietly missing from the prompt
The mapper's precedence ladder exists to avoid a silent failure — internalise it before writing your own
Resolver patches are mostly inert — only reasoningConfig is consumed; everything else compiles and changes nothing
.required with an empty tool list throws instead of degrading to plain generation
Tool calls with an unrecognised name are dropped silently — the tool never fires, no error surfaces
If thinking exhausts the budget before </think>, phase 2 is skipped entirely — no structured output at all
Re-serialize before the $defs rewrite and escaped slashes stop the prefix matching — the rewrite silently no-ops
Usage is never forwarded to the framework — Foundation Models usage metrics stay empty on the MLX path
MLXDownloadProgress lives and dies with the adapter's gate — disable the trait and dependent UI stops compiling
TokenizerInfo.init defaults vocabType .raw; sessions default .byteLevel — hand-built infos silently use wrong semantics
GuidedGenerationLoop.run must not be called from @MainActor — the README's warning is load-bearing
GrammarTokenizer registers exactly one stop token with xgrammar — other stop tokens are not enforced
Rejected fast-forward tokens silently fall back to masked sampling — correct but slower; only the counter shows it
Batching forced tokens with a populated cache hits an MLX causal-mask bug — the loop feeds them one at a time
Each helper call scans the full vocabulary (three passes on a 150k vocab) — cache biases and GrammarTokenizer
The vendored xgrammar is pinned at v0.1.30 — upstream fixes past that version are absent
flushLogs() always returns nil — the log-retrieval API hands back nothing, ever
The bridge's stopTokenIds parameter is dead — accepted, never forwarded
